ops:
No matter how many comrades
you bury...

...it never gets easier to say goodbye
to a friend.

Stern had counted upon him to hold the
squadron together...
...but now that job has fallen to me.
It's a job I've always wanted...
I'd bring you back if I could.

But all of us, sooner or later,
come to this end.
A shallow grave in a foreign country...
